Good progress — 3 regions instead of 7, text-only false positives gone. Now the two remaining problems:

**Problem 1:** Candidates 2 (1176,791, 1037×1149) and 1 (529,1691, 817×293) are merging. Their bounding rects overlap (candidate 2 spans y=791–1940, candidate 1 starts at y=1691), so gap=0, which bypasses the size check. Their area ratio is ~5×, which should prevent merging — but the `and gap > 20` condition lets it through. Fix: always apply the size check regardless of gap.

**Problem 2:** Candidate 2 (1037×1149) is itself too large — it's already spanning multiple woodcuts before any merging. Dilation kernel of 20px is still bridging gaps between nearby illustrations. Likely needs to come down to 10–12px.
